Similarly, consider later elements at distance >= x: j >= i + x; but we can process forward.

Simplify: Use a balanced BST or sorted container to maintain values from left side as we scan. As we iterate i from 0..n-1, before processing i, we insert nums[i - x] into a sorted list (when i >= x). Then we query the sorted list for value closest to nums[i] (min abs diff). That yields min diff for left side pairs where j <= i - x.

Similarly, we need to consider right side: For each i, we need j >= i + x. Equivalent to scanning from right and maintaining sorted list of values seen that are at least x ahead.
